title: Shelf Dispatch
caption: Verified films. Halfway frames. One reason each is in the drop.

items.why: Adjacent slide from POWLAX, the help call before the recovery.
Twenty minutes of wall ball for a player still learning the clock.

One head, from empty to strung, in a single sitting.

Ten box-defense words, named on the film before the drill starts.
The PLL at the Nasdaq bell. One minute on the business shelf.
